scientific_decision.no_longer_supported: Density-specific actively maintained local neighbor spacing or social territorial regularization from same RELEASE-2026 live-trap data.
scientific_decision.no_generalization: Do not claim universal mammalian response: frozen 6/8 preregistered generality gate failed.
scientific_decision.no_causality: m may be capture-selected, so conditioning can induce collider bias; sensitivity is neither proof of observation artifact nor proof of biology.
scientific_decision.next: Stop same-release moderator rescue; verify with independent NEON release and, for behavioral mechanisms, independent animal position/detection observations.
